5.t: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision

6.t: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺

7.t: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

8.t: so that you do not defraud the scales

9.t: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure
9.tr: Wa-aqeemul wazna bilqisti Wa-laa tukhsirul meezaan

10.t: He laid out the earth for all beings

11.t: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks

12.t: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants

13.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny

14.t: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery

15.t: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire
15.tr: Wa-khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar

16.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

17.t: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests

18.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

19.t: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water

20.t: yet between them is a barrier they never cross

21.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

22.t: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral

23.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

24.t: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains
24.tr: Wa-lahul jawaaril mun-sha'aatu fil bahri kal-a'laam

25.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

26.t: Every being on earth is bound to perish

27.t: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
27.tr: Wa-yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal-ikraam

28.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

29.t: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
29.tr: Yas'aluhoo man fis samaawaati walard; kulla yawmin huwa fee shaan

30.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

31.t: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺

32.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

33.t: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
33.tr: Yaa-ma'sharal jinni wal-insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal-ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan

34.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

35.t: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
35.tr: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarinw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

36.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

37.t: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil
37.tr: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan

38.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

39.t: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins
39.tr: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw Wa-laa jaann

40.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

41.t: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet
41.tr: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna-waasi wal-aqdaam

42.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

43.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”
43.tr: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon

44.t: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water

45.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

46.t: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens

47.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

49.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

50.t: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs

51.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

52.t: In each will be two types of every fruit

53.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

54.t: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach
54.tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan

55.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

56.t: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before
56.tr: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum Wa-laa jaaann

57.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

58.t: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral

59.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

60.t: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness

61.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

62.t: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others

63.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

65.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

66.t: In each will be two gushing springs

67.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

68.t: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates

69.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

70.t: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates

71.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

72.t: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions

73.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

74.t: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before
74.tr: Lam yatmis-hunna insun qablahum Wa-laa jaaann

75.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

76.t: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets

77.t: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

78.t: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
78.tr: Tabaarak asmu Rabbika Zil Jalaali wal-Ikraam
